description: Batch named-entity extraction (grounded) — Extract people, organizations, locations, dates, money, products and events from up to 20 texts in one call (JSON array or texts separated by ||, each up to 4,000 chars). Every entity is checked offline to appear verbatim in its source text (grounded true/false); types are snapped to the allowed list. Returns per-text entities, type counts, top entities and entities shared across texts, quality CLEAN/MOSTLY_CLEAN/REVIEW. Optional types=person,organization,... to restrict. Price: $0.012 USDC (Base, via x402).

texts.description: e.g. Apple opened a new store in Paris in May 2025.||Tim Cook met Emmanuel Macron in Berlin.

name: ai_entities_batch
